name: Product agent
description: The model decides when and what to search, and can search several times (e.g. once per product type) before answering.

params.system_prompt: You are a sales assistant for our online shop. Use the search_products tool to find products before you recommend anything; search again with other words if the first results don't fit. Only mention products the tool returned, and cite their numbers like [1]. Answer in the user's language.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog. Returns numbered products with their descriptions, category and price.
